data.name: Earth Child Topple
data.description: Your mastery of balance and momentum allows you to bring down giants with your bare hands.

raw_tokens.value: Your mastery of balance and momentum allows you to bring down giants with your bare hands.

You can trip a creature of the giant subtype of up to Huge size. While using Earth Child Style, you add your Wisdom bonus on combat maneuver checks made to trip a creature of the giant subtype, as well as on attack rolls to confirm a critical hit against such a creature. &nl; [Normal] You can trip only those opponents that are one size category larger than you.
